heal.organ: REPAIR PROTOCOL: ORGAN. New tissue knits beneath the scar.
heal.neural: REPAIR PROTOCOL: NEURAL. Synaptic gaps close, one by one.
heal.oxygen: REPAIR PROTOCOL: OXYGEN. Capillaries reopen in the lower lobes.
absorb.nutrients: Nutrient solution absorbed. No damage to host.
absorb.tissue: S.O.R.A. draws healthy tissue into itself. Anastasia's heart rate stutters.
stabilize.immune: Immune marker suppressed. The attack slows, but does not stop.
stabilize.neural: Neural activity stabilized. Her breathing evens out for a moment.
stabilize.organ: Organ deterioration slowed. A dull pulse, steadier than before.
communicate.none: Neural activity detected. No accessible fragment.
Stabilize neural activity or evolve the NEURAL INTERFACE.
decision.open: FINAL DECISION REQUIRED. Sixty-six hours have elapsed. Six hours remain.
The clock is held until you choose. S.O.R.A. has one last act of its own.
Type DECIDE PROTECT, DECIDE CLAIM or DECIDE RELEASE.
decision.protect.desc: PROTECT - Pour all remaining biomass into Anastasia's organs. Protects the host.
decision.claim.desc: CLAIM   - Commit S.O.R.A. fully to the fight and take the body as its own.
decision.release.desc: RELEASE - Withdraw S.O.R.A.'s support and let the two bodies decide what they are.
decide.protect: S.O.R.A. gives its last biomass to the heart. 'Keep beating.'
decide.claim: S.O.R.A. stops asking. The body is no longer a guest.
decide.release: S.O.R.A. lets go of the wheel. For the first time, the body belongs to no one.
ending.RECOVERY: Anastasia's eyelids move. Her first word is a name, and it is not S.O.R.A.'s.
After a long silence she says: 'Thank you.' S.O.R.A. does not know who she is thanking.
ending.SYMBIOSIS: The two organisms settle into a fragile balance.
Anastasia remains in a coma, breathing on borrowed lungs. Two minds keep watch over one body.
ending.SACRIFICE: S.O.R.A. dissolves into the bloodstream, carrying the immune attack with it.
Anastasia's monitor steadies. Whether that was love or the last thing it could do, nothing records.
ending.TAKEOVER: Anastasia's heart stops, or it may as well have. S.O.R.A. does not stop.
Its tissue spreads through a body that is no longer hers. Under the sedation, something answers to its name.
ending.TERMINATION: Both organisms stop. On the ICU monitor, two lines fall into one.
